observations: Line 3 condition is inverted relative to the stated contract: `name == null ? name.trim() : ""` calls `name.trim()` when name is null, which throws NullPointerException.
For non-null input the ternary returns the empty string "", so surrounding whitespace is never stripped, contradicting the contract.
Probe p1 `Display.name(null)` is predicted to throw NullPointerException rather than return empty.
Probe p2 `Display.name(" Ada ")` is predicted to return "" rather than "Ada".
The two ternary branches appear swapped; the correct form would be `name == null ? "" : name.trim()`.
static_findings is empty, so no tooling flagged this inverted-branch defect.
